scope: Remove two unsupported current sign placements only; preserve all existing architecture, glazing, cornices and panels.
policy: Use map labels for names. Retain only source-supported defining architectural signage fitted to its actual panel and wall plane.

decisions.sourceObservation: The original close street photo clearly shows white DE PLANTAGE lettering inside the central dark/glazed doorway transom below the stone cornice. The modeled dark lettering above the entrance crossed cornice bands and did not occupy that real transom.
decisions.uncertainty: Real lettering is established, but exact transom dimensions, present-day state and defining architectural status remain unverified. No guessed lettering or replacement panel is authored.

decisions.sourceObservation: The original close photo shows tiny MICROPIA markings low on several hall window panes. The wider street photo does not establish the large word sign on the right pavilion at the modeled position.
decisions.uncertainty: Occlusions and photo scale do not prove absence of every real sign. The inspected evidence does not support the large pavilion placement; pane markings are not reconstructed.
